title: Add a cashier or staff account
text: A user is just a staff account. The form has three parts: User Details, Permissions, and Branches.
steps: Click Sidebar > Users & Security.
Click Add Users.
In User Details, type the employee name, employee number, and hire date. Pick their role.
Choose how they will sign in: Tenant & PIN, or Email & Password.
Open the Permissions tab and choose what they are allowed to access.
Open the Branches tab and Click the branches where they work. Then click Save.

title: PIN login with the tenant code
text: Staff can sign in with the tenant code and a six-digit PIN instead of using an email and password.
steps: Click Sidebar > Users & Security.
Open the user account and choose the Tenant & PIN sign-in method. Set a six-digit PIN.
Each PIN must be different from other staff in the store. An email is still needed to recover the account.
Find the tenant code under Settings > Account & Subscription.
On the login page, choose Tenant & PIN and enter both values.

title: Reset a password or PIN
text: An admin can change a staff member's password or PIN from the user form. Staff who have an email address can also use Forgot Password on the login page.
steps: Click Sidebar > Users & Security.
Double-click the user and open the Edit form.
In User Details, type a new password or a new six-digit PIN.
Leave the field empty if you want to keep the old one.
Or In login page, click Forgot Password. Type the email address and follow the instructions in the email.
Click Save.

title: Change what a user can do
text: A user's permissions come from their role. If you want to change permissions for one person only, use Special Access.
steps: Click Sidebar > Users & Security.
Double-click the user and open the Permissions tab.
Change the role to load a different set of default permissions.
Click Edit under Special Access, type the supervisor password, and turn individual permissions on or off.
Click Save. If you change a role later, it does not update users that were already created from that role. You must edit those users one by one.

title: Create a custom role
text: Roles & Permissions stores the roles you can assign to staff. The built-in roles cannot be edited, but you can create your own.
steps: Click Sidebar > Settings, then Roles & Permissions.
Click Add Role and type a name for the new role.
Turn each permission on or off based on what the staff member should be allowed to do.
Click Save. Then choose this new role on the user form.

title: Let a user work in more branches
text: Use the Branches tab to choose where a user can sign in. One user account can work in multiple branches.
steps: Click Users & Security in the sidebar.
Double-click the user and open the Branches tab.
click each branch where they should be allowed to work.
Click Save. You can only assign branches that you are allowed to manage, unless you are the owner.

title: User slots and limits
text: A user slot is the permission that lets someone sign in. The slots are shared by the whole account, not by each branch.
steps: Click Sidebar > Users & Security.
Look at the line above the list to see how many slots you have and how many are already used.
Click the arrow at the end of a row to give a user a slot or free up a slot.
If a slot is inactive, it means your plan has more users than allowed. The newest users will stop working first.
To buy more, click Sidebar > Settings, then Account & Subscription, then Add User Slots.

title: Deactivate or bring back a user
text: Deleting a user does not remove them completely. It only turns them inactive so they can no longer sign in.
steps: Click Sidebar > Users & Security.
Click the arrow at the end of the user row, then choose Delete.
If needed, Click Free up slot so another person can use that slot.
To bring the user back, set the filter to Inactive, click the arrow on their row, and choose Activate.
